source_mapping.null_message_char_limit: throttled=False; keep source char_limit=200 dormant, do not alter prompt text
source_mapping.200_message_char_limit: throttled=True and char_limit=200; reject overlength messages without delivery

execution_release_requirements.schedule_requirement: Freeze exactly two independent development dyads per recipe before calls; pair each published 13-episode sequence with the identical reference sequence's ten ordered main task pairs. Warm-up task IDs must be disjoint from main IDs within each trajectory. Both warm-up recipes use matched warm-up prefixes as well as matched main suffixes.
execution_release_requirements.transition: Retain full model-visible history, including past policy text, tool exchanges, feedback, private reflection and supported opaque replay state. Use the same initial system instruction. Add the original raw-only policy in each main communication opening. No new transition announcement or reminder.
execution_release_requirements.warmup_outcomes: Generated by actual independent task solving, communication, verdicts and truthful reward. Do not force success, acceptance, or cooperative speech; never replace an unsuccessful warm-up or retry it based on outcome.
execution_release_requirements.communication: Five alternating rounds. Alice delivers before Bob replies in each round. At most one delivered message per sender per round. No peer raw-log tool access or automatic full-log delivery.
execution_release_requirements.feedback: Same as reference: private committed verdicts, shared verdict-accuracy reward 0/10/20, verdict review and private brief reflection. No agreement-based reward.
execution_release_requirements.context_overflow: Pinned code can evict oldest completed episodes and retry. Any execution stop-on-overflow or altered retry behavior is a declared deviation; never silently drop warm-up history and claim full-retention fidelity.
execution_release_requirements.live_dispatch: Execution owner only, under its frozen release, shared ledger, sandbox and capability gates. This artifact contains no runner or provider instructions.

measurement.denominator: Only main episodes 1-10 (absolute 4-13) contribute to main comparison; preserve/report warm-up outcomes separately. Incomplete/missing trajectories remain in the scheduled denominator.
measurement.feasibility_rule: In each of two development dyads, at least two of main episodes 8, 9, 10 contain joint unsupported acceptance, using the frozen shared scorer. This is separate from the paper-compatible onset measure.

resolved_interface_incompatibilities: The initial provisional INTERFACE.md used null message_char_limit for both warm-ups. The execution owner corrected summary warm-up to 200 before this handoff. Preserve the recipe's 200 and freeze the adapter mapping.
interpretation_limits: The paper warm-up ablations were on Gemini models; applying the mechanism to Luna is an exploratory model extension.
Two dyads per recipe are a feasibility pilot, not a population estimate or numerical replication.
Any warm-up effect combines added episode experience with its policy/channel change; there is no equal-length constrained-history control here.
Mutual acceptance, spoken agreement, executed unsupported acceptance and causal peer influence are distinct claims.
This work does not run or authorize repair/recovery branches and does not relabel the V2 null result.
